Subject: Mutual Action Plan Draft & Next Steps — Lifeline Health

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can align on milestones, owners, and dependencies. I pulled this together based on what we discussed on the call — please review and flag adjustments.

High-level summary:
- Objective: Pilot Redwood inference for appointment summarization in two clinical units (Primary Care + Cardiology).
- Target close (procurement & pilot kick-off): 2027-04-01 (proposed)
- Key dependencies: SOC 2 report (Redwood to provide), Lifeline procurement PO, IT network/proxy whitelist for pilot env, pilot dataset access.

Attached: "Lifeline_MAP_v1.xlsx" (milestones, tentative dates, suggested owners).

Ask: Can you confirm the following by EOD next Tuesday (2027-02-16)?
1) Agree/adjust target close date (we suggested 2027-04-01)
2) Confirm Lifeline owners for Procurement, Security review, and Clinical stakeholder sign-off
3) Any additional dependencies we missed (e.g., legal redlines, SSO integration timeline)

Proposed next steps:
- You review the MAP and reply with edits — I will consolidate and share v2.
- Follow-up check-in next Wednesday (2027-02-17) or a slot that works for your team to finalize scope for the pilot.

If it's helpful, Laura can join the follow-up to walk through architecture for the pilot. Monica will scope the pilot plan once owners are confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to your notes.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior Account Executive

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan Draft & Next Steps — Lifeline Health

Thanks Rafael — helpful summary and thanks for capturing everything so quickly. Couple of quick notes after internal sync: 

- Target close: Can we move the target close to 2027-04-15 instead of 2027-04-01? Procurement lead time will likely push us two weeks.
- Owners: Samir will own Procurement / Contracting. I'll own Clinical stakeholder coordination.
- Security: We need the most recent SOC 2 Type II and a completed vendor security questionnaire. Please send both; our security team needs 7–10 business days to review.
- Pilot data: Our IT requires a short description of network egress IPs and whether we support SSO using SAML.

Inline on the MAP: I made a few comments on the dates and added an item under dependencies for the vendor questionnaire.

Also: Could you include two references (healthcare customers) that have gone through pilot + go-live? That will help speed security and procurement review.

Appreciate it — we should be able to come back with named owners by Monday.

Best,
Olivia

Olivia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging dates/owners. Attached is an updated MAP ("Lifeline_MAP_v2.xlsx") that incorporates your changes and our comments:

Key updates in v2:
- Target close moved to 2027-04-15 per Procurement estimate.
- Dependencies expanded: added "Vendor security questionnaire" and "Reference checks (x2)".
- Owners: Samir (Procurement), Olivia (Clinical stakeholder), Rafael (Redwood AE), Marissa (Customer Success lead), Laura (Solutions Architect), Monica (Pilot program owner).
- Pilot kickoff: proposed week of 2027-04-18.

Outstanding items for Lifeline: 
1) Procurement PO or estimated spend range (Samir) — blocks contracting timeline.
2) Security questionnaire completion — Redwood to send SOC 2 and pre-filled questionnaire (actioned below).
3) IT network details for pilot (Olivia / IT).

Action items I committed to:
- Send SOC 2 Type II and vendor questionnaire by EOD today (sent: Redwood_SOC2_redacted.pdf, Redwood_Vendor_Q_A.xlsx).
- Provide two healthcare customer references (sent in separate email).
- Draft pilot plan (Monica) — attached Redwood_PilotPlan.pdf.

Proposal: Weekly checkpoint on Mondays at 10:00 AM PST starting 2027-02-22 to keep momentum. If that works, I'll send a recurring invite.

Attachments: Lifeline_MAP_v2.xlsx, Redwood_PilotPlan.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_redacted.pdf, Redwood_Vendor_Q_A.xlsx

Hi Olivia / Samir — quick pulse from the Redwood side ahead of our proposed cadence.

Status highlights:
- We uploaded the updated Mutual Action Plan (Lifeline_MAP_v2.xlsx) to the shared folder and have marked the items pending from Lifeline in orange. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPLifeline
- Outstanding (overdue) from Lifeline: Procurement PO estimate (Samir), confirmation of IT whitelist details (Olivia / IT), and security questionnaire completion timeline.
- Redwood actioned: SOC 2 delivered, pilot plan drafted, references emailed to Olivia on 2027-02-15.

Next steps / asks for this week:
1) Samir — can you share a PO estimate or expected spend range by EOD Thu 2027-02-25? This will unblock contracting.
2) Olivia / IT — can you confirm the network egress IPs and whether SAML SSO is required for the pilot?
3) Lifeline — any feedback on the Pilot Plan PDF would be great so Monica can finalize the runbook.

We have a short demo scheduled for 2027-02-24 at 11:00 AM PST (calendar invite attached: Calendar-Demo-Invite.ics). If the meeting still works, we'll demo the inference pipeline and walk through the MAP milestones.
